== Summary ==
Before/after images for [[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage (Errata)]]: the image of [[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage]] (published 21 December 2021, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable 8190af8]) and the image of [[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage (Errata)]] (published 11 June 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable 6894629]). Both whole images side by side, each reduced to 45% (so the two sizes compare as published: 745×534 and 1039×745 pixels). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
